scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @releasedesk/api" "npm run dev -w @releasedesk/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @releasedesk/contracts && npm run build -w @releasedesk/api && npm run build -w @releasedesk/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
